Question: For every \(m\) and \(k\) integers with \(k\) odd, denote by \(\left[\dfrac{m}{k}\right]\) the integer closest to \(\dfrac{m}{k}.\) For every odd integer \(k,\) let \(P(k)\) be the probability that \[\left[\dfrac{n}{k}\right]+\left[\dfrac{100-n}{k}\right]=\left[\dfrac{100}{k}\right]\] for an integer \(n\) randomly chosen from the interval \(1\le n\le99!.\) What is the minimum possible value of \(P(k)\) over the odd integers \(k\) in the interval \(1\le k\le99?\)
